messages:
alex_sales: FYI FinCorp POC goes live Mon. Need billing org + spend cap + hosted API key for devs. Also they asked for a short Dedicated pool for load tests and VPC peering for Private eval. Who can own?
maria_solutions: We can do 50k free token credit. Do you want a promo coupon or a billing project with a balance so we can track usage?
alex_sales: Billing project with balance. Want hard spend cap. Also need per-team visibility — likely 3 dev teams. CC @chris_engineer @sam_cloudops.
chris_engineer: We can mint an org-scoped API key and optionally create 3 short-lived team keys. Can add route/model restrictions. Which models will they exercise?
alex_sales: base-llama-70b and a quant-llama-70b for regression. Throughput tests will hit Dedicated pool.
maria_solutions: I'll provision billing project `fincorp-poc` with balance 50000 USD. Recommend two-tier spend caps: soft alert 10000, hard cap 50000. Approve?
alex_sales: Approved. Add me and FinCorp_SRE as viewers, eng@redwood as admins.
sam_cloudops: For Dedicated: can allocate 2xA100 for 72h. Need approval from finance, and a ticket for VPC peering. Timeline 48-72h after CIDR and approval.
chris_engineer: Plan for hosted key perms:
```
permissions: ["read:models", "invoke:generate"]
models_whitelist: ["base-llama-70b","quant-llama-70b"]
key_ttl_days: 30
```
I'll attach the key to the billing project and share via 1Password.
ops_bot: billing_project.create called by maria_solutions
ops_bot: project_id=bp_fincorp_poc balance=50000 currency=USD
ops_bot: spend_cap.soft=10000 spend_cap.hard=50000
maria_solutions: Done  billing project `bp_fincorp_poc` created. Invites sent to alex_sales and FinCorp_SRE.
chris_engineer: API key created sk_live_**** (rotating). Route/model restrictions applied. Key pushed to 1Password and shared with eng leads.
sam_cloudops: Tickets filed: NET-4123 for VPC peering, DED-221 for Dedicated allocation. NET-4123 needs FinCorp CIDR + contact. DED-221 awaiting finance approval.
finance_ops: Approving DED-221 for trial pool; cost owner assigned to account 342-B.
alex_sales: Sending FinCorp an email asking for CIDR and SRE contact now. I'll confirm once they reply. Action owners: maria (billing) 44C, chris (keys) 44C, sam (tickets) 44C.
FinCorp_SRE: Thanks 44B. CIDR is 10.20.0.0/16. SRE contact dan.f@fincorp.com. Please share API key via secure channel.
alex_sales: Got it. Forwarding to Sam and Chris. Will close thread after Dedicated pool live and peering confirmed.
